title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Khatarnak Ishq
desc: Arumugam, a kind-hearted and honest man, finds himself involved in a fight against corrupt politicians after he protests against the pollution of water in his village.

title: Dr.56
desc: A CBI officer investigating the murder of three neurosurgeons meets a theatre artist suffering from a mysterious illness, her prime suspect.
When mobiles start flying from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and his robot Nila are asked to help. However, due to Pakshi Rajan having a hand in this, the two have to reinstate Chitti to defeat him.

title: Ten Hours
desc: While searching for a missing girl, righteous police officer Castro stumbles upon a baffling homicide involving a passenger slain in total silence. He must rush to uncover the killer.

title: Rathnam
desc: Rathnam, a henchman for MLA Panner Selvam, rescues a girl from attackers during her interview trip to Vellore. As he becomes her protector, he wonders how long he can keep her safe.
